Today I visited Happy Home Kandivali and reached the store around 10:30 AM, expecting it to be fully open and operational. However, the shop was not completely opened at that time, which was a bit disappointing. Several sections were still being arranged, and overall the store did not feel ready to welcome customers. For a well-known retail store like Happy Home, better adherence to opening timings would really improve the customer experience.
Because the store was not fully functional, browsing felt inconvenient. Some counters were not active, and staff availability was limited in certain areas. This made it difficult to ask for assistance or get proper information about products. Customers who arrive early usually expect smooth service, especially when the opening time is already mentioned.
On the positive side, Happy Home generally offers a good variety of household items, décor, and daily-use products, and the store layout is usually spacious and easy to navigate. However, the experience today did not meet expectations due to the delayed readiness.
I would suggest that the management ensure the store is fully prepared by the stated opening time so customers do not feel inconvenienced. Overall, Happy Home Kandivali has potential, but timely operations and better coordination in the morning hours would make visits more pleasant.
